name: YH Entertainment Group
summary: YH Entertainment Group, an investment holding company, operates as an artist management company in Mainland China and Korea. It provides whole lifecycle of artist management, including artist training, operation, and promotion. The company's artist management services include participating in various commercial activities, such as endorsement deals, business promotion events, and commercial performances; and providing entertainment content services, including performing in movies, drama series, and variety programs.
